title: A table for two
text: Linh has an appointment at the dentist at four. After that she wants to reserve a table at a small restaurant near the station. The restaurant is crowded on Fridays, so she calls first. The man on the phone recommends a quiet corner next to the window. He says a table is available at six. Linh picks up a friend at the entrance at half past five, and they get to the restaurant on foot. They spend time with their old teacher once a week.

questions.q: Why does Linh call the restaurant first?
questions.explain: The restaurant is crowded on Fridays, so she calls first.

options: A quiet corner next to the window
